card.name: Modifier before a container noun
card.fires_on: A modifying word or word start right before a container noun such as bottle, container, bag, tube or can. Seen in preparation and dilution instructions, e.g. 'mixing' or 'infusion'.

modes.label: Mixing or infusion container
modes.description: The word 'mixing' or 'infusion' just before container, bottle or bag in prep steps.
modes.example: pour the contents of one bottle of sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate, and magnesium sulfate oral solution into the<< mixing>> container provided.

modes.label: Partway through a word or label
modes.description: A word start or quote mark inside a name that will be followed by a vessel or tube word.
modes.example: Draw off the supernatant into the "Waste<<">> tube.

card.writes: It favors singular container or grouping nouns like band, box, bucket and folder next, and disfavors plural group words like bars and batches.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a container word like bag, bottle or tube is about to come, as in mixing or diluting steps.
